title: Remove Python migration comments from TypeScript source and clean .gitignore

subtasks.content: Replace the file-header comment block (lines 1–13) in `vscode-extension/src/server/server.ts` with a self-contained description of the TypeScript LSP server architecture, removing all references to Python, pygls, and the rewrite

Update the `getThreadingMetrics()` comment on line 1373 of `vscode-extension/src/server/server.ts` from 'TypeScript server doesn't have threading like Python' to a positive description of the single-threaded event-loop model
Update the comment on line 97 of `vscode-extension/src/test/suite/commands.test.ts` from 'depending on whether Python/LSP server is available' to reference only LSP server availability
Remove the `pygls-workspace/` and `vscode-python-tools-template/` entries (lines 14–16) and the 'Reference repositories' section header from the root `.gitignore`
Grep all `.ts` files under `vscode-extension/src/` for remaining references to 'Python', 'pygls', or migration-comparative language to confirm completeness
Verify that CK3 game-data `// legacy format` and `// Legacy:` comments in `completions.ts`, `loader.ts`, and `validator.ts` are unchanged
Run `task lint` and confirm zero warnings
Run `task format:check` and confirm no formatting regressions
